title: Second tape: Dawson's full name
summary: A new tape starts; the interviewer sets up the machine and confirms Dawson's full name as Edward Joseph.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: This is Rio 3, Eddie Dawson, January the 31st, 1962. You want to sit here and watch the machine Barry? That'll make it easier for me. Sure. And the donut's going to come. We've got minus one mark on top, you see. Okay. Let's see. Can we get your name on here again? Yeah. Your full name, I never did get that. Eddie Dawson. That's your full name? Yeah. No middle name? No.
Joseph. Joseph, huh? Edward Joseph, Eddie Joseph.
And you mentioned some guys gave you a nickname, huh?
